name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🏠 ✏️ Change what's on Home (at the bottom of Home): tap cards to show or hide them, or pick 🌱 Simple or 🐝 Everything. New beekeepers start on Simple.
👥 Settings › What the app shows: a Join a club button, for when you get a club code.
🗑️ Deleting an apiary with hives asks first: delete its hives too, or keep them.
📦 Where are they going? Tick hives and tap the apiary they're going to, a group at a time. Also from 📦 Move hives… under Unassigned.
🔢 Moving a hive into a yard that already has its number: it gets the next free number, or type a name of your own.
🗣️ Say "move Hive 5 to Creek Side" to move a hive to another apiary. Buddy reads it back; if that yard has a Hive 5, he picks the next free number, or say "call it" and a name.
🔒 Settings › App version: a link to the privacy policy.
🚚 Changed where an apiary is? Say whether it moved or you're fixing a mistake, so earlier inspections stay where they happened.
